description: A trial whose D_PDUs the peer's acknowledgement marks all failed is a failed trial at once, though dts.ack_wait stops without expiring: for the rung only an acknowledgement of the transmission's D_PDUs is an answer.
note: Link setup as dts-arq/ack-wait-expiry-retransmit: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call (request at 75000 at drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long, EOW EMPTY to a peer of unknown edition), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link (16-bit family) and records the peer Ed4 (B-0408). That D_PDU's EOW is MAX-SPEED WN 4 Long (0x8A4: interleaver 101, speed 4), recorded (interp C-1262). On D_CONNECTION_MADE the rung the link was made at, drc.default_speed, position 0, counts as the last answered (interp C-1281). A transmission goes at the recommended rung, with no climb limit (corpus 0.36.0, P7-9 round 3; before, at most one above the last answered rung), except that after a failed trial it goes no higher than the answered rung until the peer answers; a transmission of ARQ data above the answered rung is a trial, and a dts.ack_wait expiry with none of the D_PDUs of the last transmission that carried ARQ data acknowledged is a silent wait, whatever else the peer has sent (open question 16; coordinator ruling 2026-11-10, corpus 0.38.0; before, a wait with nothing heard from the peer since); a silent wait after a trial is a failed trial, which caps the peer one rung below it for tx_ceiling_initial of its transmissions to the peer, doubling on each repeat failure up to tx_ceiling_cap (design shape item 7, interp C-1281); tx_step_down_waits silent waits in a row step down one rung (plan 6.2, interp C-1282); an acknowledgement of one of those D_PDUs (or, after a transmission with no ARQ data, any answer, C-1250) ends the silence count and the step down and makes that transmission's rung the answered one when it is higher. Every data D_PDU to the peer is the first header to it in its transmission and carries SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04 (interp C-1286); PADDING carries MAX-SEGMENT 255 (interp C-1271, C-1272). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; WN 2 Long 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, WN 4 Long 50 bytes and 2400 ms (test data). The 29-byte DATA-ONLY needs two blocks at WN 2 Long (EOT 20, its PADDING in block 1 EOT 10, 10350 ms) and one at WN 4 Long (EOT and the PADDING's EOT ceil(2550 / 500) = 6, 3150 ms; one PADDING, 11 bytes). Each data transmission is one D_PDU, within one block of the MAX-SPEED rung, so for latency, and with no LOW-SPEED, MAX-SPEED stands in (interp C-1284, C-1285). dts.ack_wait_ms 60000; after our own transmission, a queue that refills with nothing heard goes through LBT rule 3, 3000 ms (K-0071, K-0074); after a burst addressed only to us, rule 1 (K-0067). Contention waits are seed 0's draws, uniform(16) x 3000 ms (K-0080). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node's own MAX-SPEED and LOW-SPEED never get a value (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6) and the mixed rotation it sends each Ed4 peer it has heard is MAX-SEGMENT 255 alone (0xAFF; no SENDER-APPROACH has come, C-0956; interp C-1271, C-1272), with no top priority; sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. At 108000 'ping' (FSN 0) goes at WN 4 Long, the MAX-SPEED rung, one above the answered rung drc.default_speed WN 2 Long: a trial. The peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 0 and no selective bits follows: FSN 0 is at the RX LWE, so the peer has not received it (C-0776) and it has failed (C-0908, C-0910, interp C-1121); nothing awaits an acknowledgement, so dts.ack_wait stops (C-1120) without an expiry. The ACK is an answer for link failure (C-1250) but acknowledges none of the trial's D_PDUs and fails every one, so the trial is unanswered as at an expiry (interp C-1281 as revised in corpus 0.38.0): a failed trial (before, the trial was neither answered nor failed and FSN 0 went again at WN 4 Long, a trial again). The peer is capped at WN 2 Long for tx_ceiling_initial 2 transmissions and, until a transmission is answered, nothing goes above the answered rung. The burst was addressed only to us: LBT rule 1 from its predicted end, then contention, and FSN 0 is retransmitted at WN 2 Long, keeping its size (C-0549), not a trial. The ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1) acknowledges it: answered; the queue is empty, so dts.ttd is cancelled and the idle wait starts (A-0321: three answer waits, 180000).
